nodes.title: SG-8.3.1 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md still says the repo holds only README.md with an UNKNOWN stack. The code is TypeScript with Phaser 3.90, React, Radix, Zustand and Vitest, in game/src, game/frontend/src and game/docs, plus a Go backend that is out of scope. Desired behavior: context.md names that stack, has a module table, and drops the README-only sections. Expected result: both context.md unit tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts pass. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when STACK_TERMS (Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest) are checked, then none are missing and 'Frameworks: UNKNOWN' is absent
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths runs, then it returns game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, and every path exists
- Given context.md, then it contains no 'hello Worldseed', Purpose, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta or Residual unknowns README-only text, and no 'Traceability index'


## Scope
- In scope: Repo-root context.md content
- Out of scope: backend/ Go changes
- Out of scope: GDD feature index (SG-8.3.2)
- Out of scope: gameplay changes
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- Preserve: npm test and typecheck green in game/ and game/frontend/
- Preserve: no source file over 200 lines
- Preserve: backend and API untouched


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; no Phaser 4 migration
- No test is deleted or skipped
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- No change to what the player sees or can do


## Definition of done
- Both failing context.md unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md has a real module table and no README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: the Modules table lists README.md only, and Purpose, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta, Residual unknowns and the Traceability index describe a README-only repo. Desired behavior: a module table covering game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, and those stale sections removed. Expected result: every path named exists. Why: docs match the tree.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths runs, then the result contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/
- Given each returned path, when checked on disk from the repo root, then it exists
- Given context.md, then it has no 'hello Worldseed', 'Traceability index' or 'Executable / server / CLI `main` | UNKNOWN' text


## Scope
- In scope: Modules table and removal of stale sections in context.md
- Out of scope: Stack section
- Out of scope: GDD content
- Preserve: backend and API untouched


## Technical constraints
- Backend (Go) out of scope
- Every path named must exist
- Every step lands green in game/ and game/frontend/


## Definition of done
- Module-path test passes and stale text is gone


## Clarifying questions
- None
